31888-some-conditions-of-child-life-in-e.title: Child Life In England.
31888-some-conditions-of-child-life-in-e.creator: Rev. Benjamin Waugh,
31888-some-conditions-of-child-life-in-e.description: A book by Rev. Benjamin Waugh,. Side by side with these conditions there is an increasing tendency to regard human beings as protoplasm; to shake off the idea of Jesus as to a living God, the Father of us all, and to account for human life by molecules; to count His judgment day and a supreme judge of robust and wholesome righteousness as superstitions.

arxiv-1909-06533.title: Neuromodulated Patience for Robot and Self-Driving Vehicle Navigation
arxiv-1909-06533.creator: Jinwei Xing, Xinyun Zou, Jeffrey L. Krichmar
arxiv-1909-06533.description: Abstract Robots and self-driving vehicles face a number of challenges when navigating through real environments. Successful navigation in dynamic environments requires prioritizing subtasks and monitoring resources. Animals are under similar constraints. It has been shown that the neuromodulator serotonin regulates impulsiveness and patience in animals.

arxiv-2102-07635.title: Improved Customer Transaction Classification using Semi-Supervised Knowledge Distillation
arxiv-2102-07635.creator: Rohan Sukumaran Applied Research, Swiggy rohan.s16@iiits.in
arxiv-2102-07635.description: Abstract In pickup and delivery services, transaction classification based on customer provided free text is a challenging problem. It involves association of a wide variety of customer inputs to a fixed set of categories while adapting to the various customer writing styles.

arxiv-2107-14278.title: Series reversion with Jacobi and Thron continued fractions
arxiv-2107-14278.description: Abstract Using ordinary and exponential generating functions, we explore the reversion of power series defined by 2 2 nd order recurrences. We express the reversions in terms of Jacobi and Thron continued fractions. We find relations with Eulerian expressions using a transformation of continued fractions. Paul Barry School of Science Waterford Institute of Technology Ireland pbarry@wit.

arxiv-2202-09821.title: Generating Quality Grasp Rectangle using Pix2Pix GAN for Intelligent Robot Grasping
arxiv-2202-09821.creator: Vandana Kushwaha, Priya Shukla, G C Nandi
arxiv-2202-09821.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Vandana Kushwaha, Priya Shukla, G C Nandi. Intelligent robot grasping is a very challenging task due to its inherent complexity and non availability of sufficient labelled data. Since making suitable labelled data available for effective training for any deep learning based model including deep reinforcement learning is so crucial for successful grasp learning, in this paper we propose to solve the problem of generating grasping Poses/Rectangles using a Pix2Pix Generative Adversarial Network (Pix2Pix GAN), which takes an image of an object as input and

arxiv-2205-12857.title: Structure and Intensity Unbiased Translation for 2D Medical Image Segmentation Thanks: T. Zhang, X. Jia, J. Bartlett, X. Cheng A. Leonardis and J. Duan are with the University of Birmingham, Birmingham, UK. J. Bartlett is also with the University of Melbourne, Victoria, Australia A. Leonardis and J.
arxiv-2205-12857.creator: Tianyang Zhang, Shaoming Zheng, Jun Cheng, Xi Jia, Joseph Bartlett, Xinxing Cheng, Zhaowen Qiu
arxiv-2205-12857.description: Abstract Data distribution gaps often pose significant challenges to the use of deep segmentation models. However, retraining models for each distribution is expensive and time-consuming. In clinical contexts, device-embedded algorithms and networks, typically unretrainable and unaccessable post-manufacture, exacerbate this issue. Generative translation methods offer a solution to mitigate the gap by transferring data across domains.

arxiv-2209-07046.title: Exploring Visual Explanations for Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training Thanks: Corresponding author. We will release the code upon acceptance at https://github.com/xmed-lab/ECLIP. Affiliation: Yi Li, Hualiang Wang, Yiqun Duan, Xiaomeng Li
arxiv-2209-07046.description: Abstract Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP) learns rich representations via readily available supervision of natural language. It improves the performance of downstream vision tasks, including but not limited to the zero-shot, long tail, segmentation, retrieval, caption, and video. However, the visual explainability of CLIP is rarely studied, especially for the raw feature map.

arxiv-2412-19568.title: Signatures of the quantum skyrmion Hall effect in the Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang model
arxiv-2412-19568.creator: Reyhan Ay, Adipta Pal, Ashley M. Cook
arxiv-2412-19568.description: Abstract Given recent discovery of the quantum skyrmion Hall effect, we re-examine the related canonical Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang (BHZ) model for the quantum spin Hall insulator. Within the framework of the quantum skyrmion Hall effect, isospin degree(s) of freedom of the BHZ model encode additional spatial dimensions.

arxiv-2501-05494.title: Soft Computing Approaches for Predicting Shade-Seeking Behaviour in Dairy Cattle under Heat Stress: A Comparative Study of Random Forests and Neural Networks
arxiv-2501-05494.creator: S. Sanjuan, Daniel Alexander Méndez Reyes, R. Arnau, J. M. Calabuig, Xabier Diaz de Otalora Aguirre, Fernando Estellés Barber
arxiv-2501-05494.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by S. Sanjuan, Daniel Alexander Méndez Reyes, R. Arnau, J. M. Calabuig, Xabier Diaz de Otalora Aguirre, Fernando Estellés Barber. Heat stress is one of the main welfare and productivity problems faced by dairy cattle in Mediterranean climates.

arxiv-2502-11126.title: In Situ Optimization of an Optoelectronic Reservoir Computer with Digital Delayed Feedback
arxiv-2502-11126.description: Abstract Abstract Reservoir computing (RC) is a powerful computational framework that addresses the need for efficient, low-power, and high-speed processing of time-dependent data. While RC has demonstrated strong capabilities in signal processing and pattern recognition, its practical deployment in physical hardware is hindered by a critical challenge: the lack of efficient, scalable parameter optimization methods for real-world implementations.

arxiv-2507-12236.title: Generate to Ground: Multimodal Text Conditioning Boosts Phrase Grounding in Medical Vision-Language Models
arxiv-2507-12236.creator: Felix Nützel 1, Mischa Dombrowski 1, Bernhard Kainz 1,2
arxiv-2507-12236.description: Abstract Phrase grounding, i.e. , mapping natural language phrases to specific image regions, holds significant potential for disease localization in medical imaging through clinical reports. While current state-of-the-art methods rely on discriminative, self-supervised contrastive models, we demonstrate that generative text-to-image diffusion models, leveraging cross-attention maps, can achieve superior zero-shot phrase grounding performance.

arxiv-2507-19350.description: Abstract The polar mid-infrared (MIR) emission detected from tens to hundreds of parsecs in some active galactic nuclei (AGN) has been associated with dusty winds driven away by radiation pressure. However, the physical characterization of this extended polar emission remains uncertain.

arxiv-2509-14535.title: Secondary bow with ripples in 12 C+ 12 C rainbow scattering
arxiv-2509-14535.creator: S. Ohkubo, Y. Hirabayashi
arxiv-2509-14535.description: Abstract We report, for the first time, the emergence of a secondary bow with ripples in 12 C+ 12 C nuclear rainbow scattering. This finding was achieved by studying the experimental angular distributions in 12 C+ 12 C scattering at incident energies E L E_{L} = 240 and 300 MeV, utilizing an extended double-folding model.

arxiv-2511-15801.title: Intersection of curves in ℙ 4 \mathbb{P}^{4}
arxiv-2511-15801.creator: Luca Chiantini, Łucja Farnik, Giuseppe Favacchio, Brian Harbourne, Juan Migliore, Tomasz Szemberg and Justyna Szpond
arxiv-2511-15801.description: Abstract . Given positive integers n n , d 1 d_{1} and d 2 d_{2} , it is natural to seek a sharp upper bound for the number of intersection points of reduced, irreducible curves C 1 C_{1} and C 2 C_{2} of those degrees in ℙ n \mathbb{P}^{n} . When n = 2 n=2 this is trivial.

arxiv-2601-03635.title: Comparison and Rigidity Theorems for geodesic curvatures in two dimensional Alexandrov spaces
arxiv-2601-03635.creator: Le Ma, John Man Shun Ma
arxiv-2601-03635.description: Abstract . In this work, we study geodesic curvature of the boundary of a two dimensional Alexandrov space of curvature bounded below (CBB). We prove several comparison and globalization theorems for the geodesic curvature, generalizing the known results for curves in space of curvature bounded above (CBA) [ 1 ] .

britannica-1911-shankarsett-jagannath.title: Shankarsett, Jagannath (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-shankarsett-jagannath.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-shankarsett-jagannath.description: Article 'Shankarsett, Jagannath' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 24), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. leader of the Hindu community of Bombay for more than forty years, was born in 1800 into a family of goldsmiths of the Daivadnya caste. pmc-10585233.creator: Mayra Agustina Ríos Medrano, María Mercedes Bigi, Paloma Martínez Ponce, Ernesto Jorge Podesta, Ulises Daniel Orlando
pmc-10585233.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Adrenocortical carcinoma (ACC) is a rare and malignant disease, with more than 50 % of patients developing hormone-secreting tumors. These tumors are genetically heterogeneous and potentially lethal, as metastasis is often underway at the time of diagnosis.

pmc-10641401.title: Thyroid nodule malignancy is associated with increased non-invasive hepatic fibrosis scores in metabolic subjects
pmc-10641401.creator: Lucilla Crudele, Fabio Novielli, Carlo De Matteis, Stefano Petruzzelli, Patrizia Suppressa, Elsa Berardi, Gianfranco Antonica, Giuseppina Piazzolla, Carlo Sabbà, Giusi Graziano, Antonio Moschetta
pmc-10641401.description: IntroductionThyroid cancer incidence is increasing, and adiposity-related conditions are gaining space in its pathogenesis. In this study, we aimed to detect any anthropometric, biohumoral, and clinical features that might be associated with thyroid nodule malignancy, potentially representing novel non-invasive markers of thyroid cancer.

pmc-11510388.title: Stratification of Gut Microbiota Profiling Based on Autism Neuropsychological Assessments
pmc-11510388.creator: Chiara Marangelo, Pamela Vernocchi, Federica Del Chierico, Matteo Scanu, Riccardo Marsiglia, Emanuela Petrolo, Elisa Fucà, Silvia Guerrera, Giovanni Valeri, Stefano Vicari, Lorenza Putignani
pmc-11510388.description: Autism spectrum disorder (ASD) is a neurodevelopmental disorder. Investigations of gut microbiota (GM) play an important role in deciphering disease severity and symptoms. Overall, we stratified 70 ASD patients by neuropsychological assessment, based on Calibrated Severity Scores (CSSs) of the Autism Diagnostic Observation Schedule-Second edition (ADOS-2), Child Behavior Checklist (CBCL) and intelligent quotient/developmental quotient (IQ/DQ) parameters.

pmc-11860991.title: The Portuguese version of the Screen for Disordered Eating: Validity and reliability in the perinatal period
pmc-11860991.creator: A T Pereira, R Lima, J M Pinto, D Pereira, A Macedo, C Marques, A I Araújo, B Barbosa, C Pinto Gouveia
pmc-11860991.description: IntroductionDespite the increased knowledge about the prevalence and consequences of eating disorders (ED), they continue to be underdiagnosed and undertreated. Being more common in women of childbearing age, the perinatal period may play a decisive role in the incidence and course of these pathologies. The Screen for Disordered Eating (SDE) was developed for the screen of ED in primary care.

pmc-12110563.title: International Internship Collaborations: Rwandan Nephrology Graduate Nurses Describe Their Experiences Abroad
pmc-12110563.creator: Gerard Nyiringango, Pamela Meharry, Sandra MG Musabwasoni, Alice Nyirazigama, Lakshmi Rajeswaran
pmc-12110563.description: BackgroundInternational internships provide many benefits to graduate nurses, including bridging the gap between theory and practice. Yet, these internships in culturally diverse regions also present various challenges.ObjectiveThis study explored the experiences gained by nephrology graduate master's nurses from the University of Rwanda who attended clinical training in more advanced settings in Asia and Africa.

pmc-12591511.title: An integrated One Health initiative for pathogen genomic surveillance in the UK
pmc-12591511.creator: Yogesh K. Gupta, Ian Adams, Ronny van Aerle, Justin Avant, David Bass, Frederico M. Batista, Marco Benucci, Tiernan Briggs, Irene Cano, Bhudipa Choudhury, Bridget Crampton, Richard J. Ellis, Graham Freimanis, Edward Haynes, Sarah C. Hill, Eleanor Jones, Lynn Laurenson, Alastair Maclaren, Dan Maskell
pmc-12591511.description:
A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Mirjam Schilling, Sunitha Subramaniam, Neil Taylor, Georgia M. Ward, Lisa Ward
Published: 2025

Genomic surveillance has become an increasingly important component of disease management, enabling precise identification of pathogens, real-time tracking of outbreaks and insights into host–pathogen co-evolution. Technological and analytical advances now permit high-throughput sequencing (HTS) to be undertaken across a wide range of contexts, from large-scale sequencing in genomics centres to on-site sequencing in the field.

pmc-12683122.title: Bedding’ dry sanitization with aluminosilicates affects its chemical composition, growth performance, meat quality, and footpad dermatitis incidence in broiler chickens
pmc-12683122.creator: Sebastian Wlaźlak, Jakub Biesek, Mirosław Banaszak, Szymon Różański, Marek Adamski
pmc-12683122.description: The objective of this study was to evaluate the effects of aluminosilicates used as a litter additive on production performance, carcass composition, litter chemical composition, and footpad dermatitis (FPD) in broiler chickens. A total of 240 Ross 308 broiler chicks were randomly assigned to one control group (CON) and three experimental groups.

pmc-13009484.title: Securing internet of things devices using a hybrid approach
pmc-13009484.creator: R Sherine Jenny, N Sugirtham, B Thiyaneswaran, S Kumarganesh, Martin Sagayam K, Syed Immamul Ansarullah, Farhan Amin, Isabel de la Torre Díez, Carlos Osorio García, Alina Eugenia Pascual Barrera
pmc-13009484.description: With increased Internet of Things (IoT) devices, complexity and protection are more challenging. Lightweight cryptographic algorithms are secure and suitable for limited-resource environments; however, their hash functions provide encrypted data but not integrity. Strong security features are available, but setup is difficult and expensive. Network security mechanisms increase power consumption and latency.

pmc-13059579.title: Age-Period-Cohort analysis of gonorrhea surveillance data in Eastern China from 2005 to 2024
pmc-13059579.creator: Ziyang Fang, Mingkuan Fan, Shuangqing Wang, Haocheng Wu, Qinbao Lu, Zheyuan Ding, Xinyi Wang, Junjie Li, Tianyin Fu, Kui Liu, Chen Wu, Jianmin Jiang
pmc-13059579.description: BackgroundGonorrhea poses a major public health challenge. This study analyzed the independent effects of age, period, and birth cohort on gonorrhea incidence in Eastern China to inform targeted interventions.MethodsCase data from Zhejiang Province (2005–2024) were obtained from the China Information System for Disease Control and Prevention. Age-Period-Cohort and Joinpoint regression models were used to evaluate trends and effects.

pmc-13218981.title: Effects of altitude and sociodemographic factors on cardiometabolic disorders in the southwestern plateau areas of China
pmc-13218981.creator: Nan Zhang, Wenlong Zhu, Yu Xia, Lin Duo, Zhiling Luo, Mingjing Tang, Da Zhu
pmc-13218981.description: BackgroundCardiometabolic disorders, including hypertension, dyslipidemia, and diabetes, are increasingly prevalent globally, yet evidence in economically underdeveloped high-altitude areas remains limited. This study sought to assess the prevalence and control of these diseases in the southwestern plateau areas of China and to evaluate their associations with altitude and sociodemographic factors.
